You must've understood the anxiety your mother felt better than anyone. But, Meur... simply sharing the same space with someone means becoming aware of their gaze. As long as you were there together, you must've had to bear your mother's gaze. You could hardly help but gaze her in return.

Is that why you feel guilty?
